snp3.7:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi yena āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo tadavasari,
snp3.7:1.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi āpaṇaṃ anuppatto,
snp3.7:1.5: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
snp3.7:1.6: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti
snp3.7:1.7: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamunassaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti,
snp3.7:1.8: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti,
snp3.7:1.9: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’ti.
snp3.7:2.1: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
snp3.7:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
snp3.7:2.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttepesi sampahasesi.
snp3.7:2.4: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.7:2.5: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti,
snp3.7:2.6: evaṃ vutto bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.7:2.7: mahā kho keṇiya, bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni, tvañca kho brāhmaṇesu abhippasannoti.
snp3.7:3.1: dutiyampi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.7:3.2: kiñcāpi bho gotama, mahā bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni, ahañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno,
snp3.7:3.3: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti,
snp3.7:3.4: tatiyampi kho bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.7:3.5: mahā kho keṇiya, bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni, tvañca kho brāhmaṇesu abhippasannoti,
snp3.7:4.1: tatiyampi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.7:4.2: kiñcāpi bho gotama, mahā bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni, ahañca kho brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno,
snp3.7:4.3: adhivāsetveva me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
snp3.7:4.5: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena sako assamo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā mittā macce ñātisālohite āmantesi:
snp3.7:4.6: suṇantu me bhavanetā mittā maccā ñātisālohitā
snp3.7:4.7: samaṇo me gotamo nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
snp3.7:4.9: evaṃ hoti kho keṇiyassa jaṭilassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā keṇiyassa jaṭilassa paṭissutvā appekacce uddhanāni khaṇanti, appekacce kaṭṭhāni phālenti, appekacce bhājanti dhovanti, appekacce udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpenti, appekacce āsanāni paññāpenti.
snp3.7:4.10: keṇiyo pana jaṭilo sāmaṃyeva maṇḍalamālaṃ paṭiyādeti.
snp3.7:5.1: tena kho pana samayena selo brāhmaṇo āpaṇe paṭivasati tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragu sanighaṇaṭukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo tīṇi māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti,
snp3.7:6.1: tena kho samayena keṇiye jaṭile selo brāhmaṇo abhippasanno hoti.
snp3.7:6.2: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi parivuto jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami.
snp3.7:6.3: addasā kho selo brāhmaṇo keṇiyasmiṃ jaṭile appekacce uddhanāni khaṇanne …pe… appekacce āsanāni paññāpente keṇiyaṃ pana jaṭilaṃ sāmaṃyeva maṇḍalamālaṃ paṭiyādentaṃ
snp3.7:6.5: kinnu bhoto keṇiyassa āvāho vā bhavissati, vihāho vā bhavissati, mahāyañño vā paccupaṭṭhito, rājā vā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyenāti.
snp3.7:7.1: na me sela, āvāho bhavissati, napi vivāho bhavissati napi rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro nimatti to svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyena,
snp3.7:7.2: api ca kho me mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito
snp3.7:7.3: atthi. samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi āpaṇaṃ anuppatto,
snp3.7:7.4: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato …pe…
snp3.7:7.6: so me nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
snp3.7:8.2: ghosopi kho eso dullabho lokasmiṃ yadidaṃ buddho’ti.
snp3.7:8.3: āgatāni kho pana asmākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
snp3.7:8.4: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavatti dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvi janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
snp3.7:8.6: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ,
snp3.7:8.7: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā,
snp3.7:8.8: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
snp3.7:8.9: sace kho panāgārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivattacchaddo.
snp3.7:8.10: kahaṃ pana bho keṇiya, etarahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati arahaṃ sammā sambuddho’ti.
snp3.7:9.1: evaṃ vutte keṇiyo jaṭilo dakkhiṇaṃ bāhaṃ paggahetvā selaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.7:9.3: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami,
snp3.7:9.4: athakho selo brāhmaṇo te māṇavake āmantesi:
snp3.7:9.5: appasaddā bhonto āgacchantu pāde padaṃ nikkhipantā,
snp3.7:9.6: durāsadā hi te bhagavanto sīhāva ekavarā,
snp3.7:9.7: yadā vāhaṃ bhonto, samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ manteyyaṃ mā me bhonto, antarantarā kathaṃ opātetha,
snp3.7:10.1: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
snp3.7:10.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni samannesi,
snp3.7:10.4: addasā kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve,
snp3.7:10.5: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati,
snp3.7:11.2: passati kho me ayaṃ selo brāhmaṇo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve,
snp3.7:11.3: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati,
snp3.7:11.5: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā addasa selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ,
snp3.7:11.6: atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi parimasi, ubhopi nāsikasotāni anumasi parimasi, kevalampi laḷāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
snp3.7:12.2: samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no aparipuṇṇehi
snp3.7:12.3: no ca kho naṃ jānāmi buddho vā no vā,
snp3.7:12.4: sutaṃ kho pana metaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ,
snp3.7:12.5: ye te bhavanti arahanto sammāsambuddho te sake vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attānaṃ pātukarontīti,
snp3.7:12.6: yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthaveyyanti,
snp3.7:12.7: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi.
snp3.7:33.1: alattha kho selo brāhmaṇo sapariso bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
snp3.7:33.2: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo tassā attiyā accayena sake assame paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi,
snp3.7:33.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi, saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
snp3.7:34.1: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
snp3.7:34.2: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
snp3.7:34.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi.
snp3.7:37.1: atha kho bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
snp3.7:37.2: atha kho āyasmā selo pasariso eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpi pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti. tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi. khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti. abbhaññāsi
snp3.7:37.3: aññataro ca kho panāyasmā selo sapariyo arahataṃ ahosi.
snp3.7:38.1: atha kho āyasmā selo sapariyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi.
